items.description: Tirkortritt loves Al Howin's Day tricks. To share his joy and love for this special day, he has decided to scatter surprise gifts all around. Trikortritt is a joker and a disciple of Asid, the god of Fear. Who knows what he could have hidden in this box?
items.name: Trikortritt Surprise

items.description: This treat was hidden in Trikortritt's surprise box. Its taste (a mixture of Cawwot, Pumpkwin and Orange Larva juice) is a delight to children, parents and even dentists.
items.name: Al Howin's Treat

items.description: This potion will allow you to teleport to the Temple of Scriptures, otherwise known as the Almanax Sanctuary. Now you have no excuse to not make an offering!
items.name: Temple of Scriptures Potion

items.description: There's nothing better than a good old-fashioned Al Howin's Lolly to get your teeth rotting nice and quick. This treat will increase your Intelligence in exchange for Vitality for your next fight.
items.name: Strawberry Lolly

items.description: There's nothing better than a good old-fashioned Al Howin's Lolly to get your teeth rotting nice and quick. This treat will increase your Strength in exchange for Vitality for your next fight.
items.name: Api Lolly

items.description: There's nothing better than a good old-fashioned Al Howin's Lolly to get your teeth rotting nice and quick. This treat will increase your Agility in exchange for Vitality for your next fight.
items.name: Lemon Lolly

items.description: There's nothing better than a good old-fashioned Al Howin's Lolly to get your teeth rotting nice and quick. This treat will increase your Chance in exchange for Vitality for your next fight.
items.name: Plum Lolly

items.description: Al Howin force-fed his Devhorror Cheweez to make it more powerful. Not only did it work, but its mouth became so saturated in sugar and cariogenic bacteria that even its gentlest bite can make your teeth fall out. This treat will dramatically increase your Power in exchange for Vitality for your next fight.
items.name: Cheweez

items.description: Not to be sold at all. This sweet is so full of psychoactive substances that it will make you believe that a Borbkin is following you. Prepare to get a fright every time you turn around.
items.name: Mind-Blowing Candy Kebab

items.description: Not to be sold at all. This sweet is so full of psychoactive substances that it will make you believe that a Toadkin is following you. Prepare to get a fright every time you turn around.
items.name: Hallucinogenic Candy Kebab

items.description: Use this scroll to learn how to shake it in the dark to make it glow. It works in the daytime too, although it's much less effective. We're talking about shaking your Pumpkwin Head... You know that, right?
items.name: Emote Scroll: Al Howin

items.description: Not to be confused with the consolation prizes you're so used to, this gift has been given to you to make up for the inconvenience you suffered. Inside, you'll find 30 compensokens that you can trade in with Pauly Gees at the Amakna Castle zaap at [3,-5].
items.name: Compensation Gift

items.description: This candy will grant you a Prospecting bonus of 100 points for your next fight.
items.name: Prospector Candy

items.description: This candy will grant you a Wisdom bonus of 100 points for your next fight.
items.name: Formative Candy

items.description: This potion is one of the most powerful an alchemist can craft and its recipe is jealously kept secret by the oldest among them. When interrogated, they have a tendency to complicate the recipe, stating that it needs ingredients that are simply impossible to find just to discourage competition.
items.name: Chichala Flask

items.description: This gift is offered as compensation for a problem in DOFUS. You can use it on any character, but only those that haven't finished the Year of the Dragon (Dolmanax) quest and have fewer than 365 Calendar Pages can be awarded one. You can collect your reward from Antyklime Ax.
items.name: Plerti's Cylinder Gift

items.description: Use this scroll to learn the Piwi emote. Mylka's disciples use it just after leaping off cliffs and just before crashing dismally in a cloud of dust.
items.name: Emote Scroll: Piwi

items.description: Use this scroll to learn the Cheer On emote. Totot, the Meridia of Enthusiasm, is always telling people to share their joy with the world rather than keeping it bottled up, so feel free to jump around and get the troops psyched up. Waahoooo!
items.name: Emote Scroll: Cheer On

items.description: You found this doughnut inside a Party Bag, and it looks so good that you're drooling. Go on, hang the diet and scoff the lot! You can shrug off your spare tyre next time the Brakmarathon comes round.
items.name: Karnaval Doughnut

items.description: What could be inside this Party Bag? The only way to find out is to take a deep breath and open it up...!
items.name: Party Bag

items.description: Consume to acquire 15 loyalokens.

effects.formatted: Gains 15x You Go Here and You Go There

items.name: Face Change Potion

items.description: Legend says that the recipe of this chewy little bar is kept secret by the god Rabmarac. Nobody can resist the authentic taste, nor the painstaking humour of the joke that can be found on the inside of the wrapper.
items.name: Caramel Rabmarac Bar

items.description: This chewy bar will light up the cheeks of girls and boys alike. Want to know why? Maybe it's because of the Rabmajoke written on the inside of the wrapper, but we can't be sure...
items.name: Strawberry Rabmarac Bar

items.description: To be consumed in moderation, especially when you're in a hurry. Take the time to read the joke on the inside of the wrapper - it'd be a real shame to miss out on it...!
items.name: Lemon Rabmarac Bar

items.description: It is said that Nitsougnal absolutely loves this chewy little sweet. Given its colour, that's probably to be expected, but he also loves the hilarious joke written on the inside of the wrapper.
items.name: Orange Rabmarac Bar

items.description: John Pesterton wanted to recreate the taste of his Cocalane and pop it into a chewy treat. The god Rabmarac is no stranger to the fact that the supposedly miraculous drink invented by the alchemist was none other than a bad joke. In any case, while the taste of this Kola bar has been imitated, the Rabmajoke that's written on the inside of the wrapper is inimitable.
items.name: Kola Rabmarac Bar

items.description: This chewy bar is reserved for dungeon keepers only. Any monster able to swallow one whole will be abandoned in the arena at the mercy of cruel and avid adventurers. Before passing away, the carefree creature is allowed to read the Rabmajoke written on in the inside of the wrapper just to get one last laugh out of life.
items.name: Nougat Rabmarac Bar

items.description: This cristalline horn contains 5 doses of a powerful healing philter. With each use, it gets slightly smaller but will keep its shape and size in the cold.
items.name: Large Unikron Horn

items.description: This cristalline horn contains 4 doses of a powerful healing philter. With each use, it gets slightly smaller, yet even if it's been used, it'll still be an acceptable shape and size.
items.name: Long Unikron Horn

items.description: This cristalline horn contains 3 doses of a powerful healing philter. With each use, it gets slightly smaller, but don't go thinking the smaller ones are the better ones.
items.name: Short Unikron Horn

items.description: This cristalline horn contains 2 doses of a powerful healing philter. With each use, it gets slightly smaller, but don't go thinking the smaller ones are the better ones.
items.name: Small Unikron Horn

items.description: This cristalline horn contains the last dose of a powerful healing philter. Once it's been used, there'll be nothing left of it. You'll need to find a bigger Unikron Horn if you're planning on impressing the apprentice alchemists.
items.name: Tiny Unikron Horn

items.description: A promising dish that will pleasantly surprise your taste buds... Once you get over the fishy smell, that is!
items.name: Snapper a la Kerub

items.description: They say that the first Pyrofuegos were particularly magnificent. Since the fires they caused were equally spectacular, explosives manufacturers saw their sales drop. They had to do something and so now spectators can stand and marvel before these beautiful lights with no fear of danger.
items.name: Pyrofuego

items.description: When you eat this sweet treat, you'll temporarily take on the appearance of a Snowball. The effects will disappear as soon as you start a fight.
items.name: Ice Sugar Snowball

items.description: When you eat this sweet treat, you'll temporarily take on the appearance of an Ice Crackler. The effects will disappear as soon as you start a fight.
items.name: Ice Sugar Ice Crackler

items.description: When you eat this sweet treat, you'll temporarily take on the appearance of a Sakai Firefoux. The effects will disappear as soon as you start a fight.
items.name: Ice Sugar Sakai Firefoux

items.description: This pastry is much more pleasant when it's not fighting back! Beware of its side effects, though...
items.name: Kwismas Pastry

items.description:
Sometimes, a Kwismas Pastry needs an extra grilling. Have a bite of this one; it'll keep you on your toes.
This pastry can only be eaten on Kwismas Island.
items.name: Kwismas Pastry Monster

items.description: This potion will allow you to teleport to Kerub Crepin's house in Astrub. It will also magically clean all that poop from the soles of your shoes!
items.name: Kerub Potion

items.description: Use this scroll to learn the Write emote. We're not expecting you to be the next Acidrik Gutsplitter, but at least don't write any more of that bwork poetry this time.
items.name: Emote Scroll: Write

items.description: You found this letter in a gift envelope. The paper shines with an iridescent gloss. Could it be magic? To know more, why don't you go and wish Kerub Crepin a merry Kwismas? He's waiting for you at his house in Astrub.
items.name: Letter from Kerub

items.description: What could be in this envelope? Open it, quick!
items.name: Gift Envelope

items.description: A compilation of the jokes printed on the backs of Rabmarac wrappers. A summit of humour for kids, grown-ups and Goblins.
items.name: Collection of Rabmajokes

items.description: This Krospack contains the Argon Gass Krosmaster figurine. Open it quick!
items.name: Argon Gass Krospack

items.description: This Krospack contains the Goultard the Barbarian Krospack. Open it quick!
items.name: Goultard the Barbarian Krospack

items.description: This Krospack contains a randomly selected Krosmaster figurine from the Brotherhood of the Tofu. Open it quick!
items.name: Brotherhood Krospack

items.description: According to the old sailors' tales, Soul Pearls are made by mermaids and left at the surface when their owners come up for a breath of fresh air and a singsong. If you swallow this pearl, you should definitely stay away from fishmongers, unless you want to end up as sushi.
items.name: Soul Pearl

items.description: Kroketh's followers can be seen furiously chomping on this kind of Gobbagum before Gobbowl matches. Made from desiccated jerky, aromatic herbs and swathes of fur, this chewy confectionery helps them seize life – and their opponents – by the throat. It also grants a nice little Prospecting bonus.
items.name: Wild Gobbagum

items.description:
Totot's disciples can be seen enthusiastically chewing on this kind of Gobbagum the night before a big match. There's nothing better for a soft complexion and a peachy glow. Made from fruit of the finest quality, it's 100% pip-free.
It also grants a nice little Vitality bonus.
items.name: Peach Gobbagum

items.description:
Kham's disciples can be seen conscientiously masticating this kind of Gobbagum at the beginning of a match, to make sure their breath stays fresh all game long. Just because you're going to give your enemy a thumping, doesn't mean you want to envelop him in morning breath. 
It also grants a nice little Power bonus.
items.name: Fresh Lavender Gobbagum

items.description: This Gobbowl Ball contains every Gobbowler's favourite type of candy: Gobbagum! It's so stretchy and sticky that you can even use it to glue on a broken tooth at the end of a rough match. Quick, open it up! Which flavour did you get?
items.name: Gobbowl Surprise

items.description: Use this scroll to learn the "Weapon Skill" spell.
items.name: Weapon Skill Scroll

items.description: Each piece of meat in this sauté tastes different, which makes it very popular with ladies who never know what to order in restaurants.
items.name: Sautéed Alchimera Flesh

items.description: This withered meat in this sauté looks like a rat that drowned in a jar of formaldehyde. Fortunately, it tastes much better than it looks.
items.name: Sautéed Nileza Flesh

items.description: Served cold, these meatballs melt in the mouth, releasing a pleasant sensation of freshness, quickly followed by a complete numbing of the tongue and lower jaw. Serve them to your mother-in-law for a blissful afternoon of peace and quiet.
items.name: Stewed Armarine Meatballs

items.description: By serving these meatballs to their menfolk, the women of Frigost can finally get their revenge. Once released into the mouth, the millions of tiny organisms they contain will never be able to reach their true destination.
items.name: Missiz Freezz's Stewed Meatballs

items.description: Despite being stewed for hours, this meat is as tough and chewy as it was when you first picked it up. You can't cut it with a knife or bite it with your teeth, so you may as well turn it into armour.
items.name: Leatherbod Sole Goulash

items.description: The Klime Sole in this dish is what gives it the flavour. It's probably best not to serve it to Iops, or you'll find them using it as a bungee rope, no matter how many times you tell them to stop playing with their food.
items.name: Klime Sole Goulash

items.description: You can now eat this meat without having to equip a set of stainless steel dentures first.
items.name: Mechaniac Meat Tenderloin

items.description: This meat was wrapped up in a dirty handkerchief, and has a unique flavour as a result. It reminds you of that basic survival class you took, when you were taught to find sustenance in the pickings from your nose.
items.name: Sylargh Meat Tenderloin

items.description: This gustatory delight would tickle the tastebuds of the god Xelor himself, if only he'd sit down for a few moments and have something to eat. There are some words on the back: "Warning, may contain small pieces of clockwork" and "Not suitable for children under 12 years of age".
items.name: Minced Sinistro Breast

items.description: Nothing else in the World of Twelve tastes quite like this. Nido, the Meridia of Gastronomy, took more than a century to perfect the recipe.
items.name: Minced Harebourg Breast

items.description: The humble story of a Frigostian shoemaker.
items.name: Klime and Punishment

items.description: This drink is good for curing stomach aches and headaches. It can also be used to clean mechanical drills, unclog the engines of Frigostian Carriers, dissolve any Chafers you may have rattling around in your closet, or as a colonic for the Yech'Ti.
items.name: Bottle of Cocalane

items.description: It's unlikely that the skidmarks on this towel come from the wheels of a Dragokart. The clue's in the smell, basically.
items.name: Lost Towel

items.description: This g-string, made from genuine nasal hair, will protect you from the many parasites that can be found in those darker places that are dedicated to debauchery and decadence. Make no mistake, this is a top quality undergarment, and its owner would be delighted to have it back.
items.name: Nose Hair G-String

items.description: This is an old copy of Nowt magazine, and now you just need to find someone who's interested in reading such a rag.
items.name: Old Magazine

items.description: This letter, sent to a resident of Castle Harebourg, never reached its owner. The postman who was supposed to deliver it no doubt ended his days as a lightshade, a frozen meal, or a stuffed blow-up doll. Still, he brought more happiness dead than he ever did alive.
items.name: Patent of Nobility

items.description: Use this scroll to learn the Spyglass emote. Whether you're mad about Olvido or more Malava's kind of adventurer, you'll always be leagues ahead of your enemies with one eye on the horizon.
items.name: Emote Scroll: Spyglass

items.description: The must-have guide for anyone who loves a party!
items.name: The Folkloric Chronicles of Anne Thrope-Oloji

items.description: According to an old wives' tale, anyone who drinks this water will feel obliged to reveal a terrible secret on the town square, in front of everyone. Luckily for you, the refreshing droplets in this flask have been diluted with Crocodyl Tears. Nobody will have to know what you did last summer.
items.name: Retsej Fountain Water

items.description: "The Lumberjacks of the Apocalypse" was an amusing alliance name when you were fifteen and dreamed of being a lumberjack. But it hasn't been much help in your romantic life, nor in recruiting other members. Give your alliance a new name and imagine a new life!
items.name: Alliance Renaming Potion

items.description: It seemed like a good idea at the time, but face it: nobody can tell that your emblem is supposed to be an emancipated Bwork hunting down his own parents to make a statement about freedom. Nobody. Do the world a favour and change that awful emblem now!
items.name: Alliance Emblem Change Potion

items.description: This magical item is the gentleman's (and gentlelady's) way to mark one's territory. It should be used to excess by all those who conquer to pass the time.
items.name: Necessary Alliance Prism

items.description: At every party, there comes a time when you desperately want to play Leap-Gobbly. This Fairywork will get your friends in the mood for a game too!
items.name: Black Gobbly Summoning Fairywork

items.description: At every party, there comes a time when you desperately want to play Leap-Gobbly. This Fairywork will get your friends in the mood for a game too!
items.name: White Gobbly Summoning Fairywork

items.description: Astonishing! You feel as though you're in a Gobball pen, just without the Gobballs!
items.name: Midgie Summoning Fairywork

items.description: If you're looking to keep your feet on the ground, this Fairywork will be no help at all.
items.name: Starry Fairywork

items.description: This Fairywork is especially popular with Boars, who set them off in great number during all kinds of celebrations, and then scurry off into the grass to truffle around for the fallen treats.
items.name: Acorntastic Fairywork

items.description: The best Fairywork on earth for celebrating Captain Chafer's Panty Party.
items.name: Brief Fairywork

items.description: A Fairywork in memory of the night when Sadida got so sick of lying in bed, wide-awake, that he got up and switched off all the stars.
items.name: Lazy Fairywork

items.description: Use with caution: in some areas, using it can be interpreted as a provocation.
items.name: Wealthy Fairywork

items.description: This Fairywork sounds nice the first time you hear it, but once you've heard 10,000 of them in a row to celebrate Gobbstock, the novelty kind of wears off.
items.name: Musical Fairywork

items.description: This Fairywork is rarely used, because it gives off a distinctive, pestilent odour. Still, it's always a good idea to have a few on you, to cover up all those... embarrassing moments.
items.name: Mush Mush Fairywork

items.description: This Fairywork will put stars in your friends' eyes. Tonight, Matthew, I'm going to be... A Wabbit!
items.name: Cawwot Fairywork

items.description: A Demonic Rose explodes over everyone's heads. Biological warfare has never been so pretty.
items.name: Flowery Fairywork

items.description: When you drink this potion, you'll fly into such a rage that any enemies that get any closer than 6 cells away will find themselves automatically attacked.
items.name: Sentinel Potion

items.description: Use this figurine to add it directly to your collection of Krosmaster figurines.
items.name: Count Harebourg

items.description: Use this figurine to add it directly to your collection of Krosmaster figurines.
items.name: Count Frigost

items.description: When leaving your enemy as quiet as the grave isn't enough for you, use this potion to send his soul straight to the cemetery without passing go.
items.name: Undertaker Potion

items.description: You were supposed to protect that adventurer, but you failed miserably. Heigh-ho, you can always use this potion to revive them and save them a trip to the cemetery.
items.name: Healer Potion

items.description: With this potion, you can teleport straight to the Alliance Temple. Now you've got no excuse for finding yourself all alone without a role whilst the battle is raging!
items.name: Alliance Temple Potion

items.description: Here's a Fairywork for the Arachneephobe in you. What could be more soothing than seeing a nasty Arachnee projected into the air and blown to pieces?
items.name: Arachnee Summoning Fairywork

items.description: The Rogues know how to use this Fairywork better than anyone. Spectacular vanishing acts guaranteed!
items.name: Cloudy Fairywork

items.description: This shape-shifting creature absorbs the appearance of the only meal it has in its life before forming a fusional symbiotic relationship with a host item of the same type. When the Mimisymbic is removed from its host by force, it loses its adhesive powers and shrivels up into a sad little ball of no use to anyone. Awww.
items.name: Mimisymbic

items.description: Wabbits are wotten... er, rotten... at spelling, as the name of this veggie demonstrates. You're so disgusted at this wanton replacement of one letter by another that the mere sight of this Cawwot makes you want to puke. Just as well, because it's past its prime.
items.name: Wotten Cawwot

items.description: The Cawwot soda that flows so freely in Gwimace's restaurants has all the same benefits as other sodas: high sugar and calorie content, brief impression of refreshment and hydration, increased risk of diabetes and cardiovascular disease, and decreased life expectancy. However, it also has something the others don't: Cawwocola teleports you straight to Isle of the Cwown!
items.name: Cawwocola

items.description: With this module, you'll be able to upgrade your alliance prism so it can teleport characters to other controlled prisms or Zaaps.
items.name: Teleportation Module

items.description: Use this potion to summon a Perceptor.
items.name: Incredible Perceptor Potion

items.description: This potion tastes good, like lemonade! Unlike lemonade, it will teleport you straight to Fattumy's Inn. Only works in Incarnam. Definitely doesn't work in the depths of a dungeon or on dark and stormy nights. Fattumy won't be there to take care of you forever, you know!
items.name: Fattumy Potion

items.description: This scroll will allow you to learn the Give a Cake emote. It's a deliciously kind thought that will charm even the sourest Mama Bwork.
items.name: Emote Scroll: Give a Cake

items.description: Use this figurine to add it directly to your collection of Krosmaster figurines.
items.name: Captain Amakna

items.description: Use this figurine to add it directly to your collection of Krosmaster figurines.
items.name: Merkator

items.description: Use this scroll to learn the Boo emote.
items.name: Emote Scroll: Boo

items.description: Use this scroll to learn the Big Wave emote.
items.name: Emote Scroll: Big Wave

items.description: Use this scroll to learn the Boxer emote.
items.name: Emote Scroll: Boxer

items.description: Use this scroll to learn the Wave the White Flag emote.
items.name: Emote Scroll: Wave the White Flag

items.description: Use this scroll to learn the Spitfire emote.
items.name: Emote Scroll: Spitfire

items.description: This manuscript is said to have been written a long, long time ago by Ereziah Melkewel, one of the most powerful Alchemists in the World of Twelve.
items.name: Alchemist's Journal - First Notebook

items.description: The next journal kept by Ereziah Melkewel. Reading it would probably be instructive.
items.name: Alchemist's Journal - Second Notebook

items.description: This copious compilation of crooks could serve as a guide to people you don't want to meet, and can do double duty as a disciplinary tool for kids: "If you don't behave, the guy on page 6 will come and get you!" Other uses include doorstop, hammer, firestarter, and we reckon it'd make a decent murder weapon.
items.name: Hall of Infamy

items.description: Use this figurine to add it directly to your collection of Krosmaster figurines.
items.name: Krobax

items.description: Use this figurine to add it directly to your collection of Krosmaster figurines.
items.name: Beelzebug

items.description: Use this figurine to add it directly to your collection of Krosmaster figurines.
items.name: Skale

items.description: Use this figurine to add it directly to your collection of Krosmaster figurines.
items.name: Trank

items.description: Use this figurine to add it directly to your collection of Krosmaster figurines.
items.name: Lumino

items.description: Use this figurine to add it directly to your collection of Krosmaster figurines.
items.name: Shadow

items.description: Use this figurine to add it directly to your collection of Krosmaster figurines.
items.name: Wakfu Terminatot

items.description: Use this figurine to add it directly to your collection of Krosmaster figurines.
items.name: Stasis Terminatot

items.description: Use this figurine to add it directly to your collection of Krosmaster figurines.
items.name: Goldenrod Terminatot

items.description: Use this figurine to add it directly to your collection of Krosmaster figurines.
items.name: Grampy

items.description: Use this figurine to add it directly to your collection of Krosmaster figurines.
items.name: Joris

items.description: Use this figurine to add it directly to your collection of Krosmaster figurines.
items.name: Kerub Crepin

items.description: Use this figurine to add it directly to your collection of Krosmaster figurines.
items.name: Lou

items.description: One mouthful of this Rump Supreme is quite enough, thank you!
items.name: Kanig Rump Supreme

items.description: The question is not whether to have breast or thigh. The question is what wine does one serve to accompany them?
items.name: Smoked Kanigrula Breast

items.description: A fillet just oozing with meaty juices - perfect for a low-fat, high-protein dinner. If you have a Trool friend coming round to eat, he'd probably prefer that weirdo you met at the inn the other night, who's richer in fats and alcohol.
items.name: Roast Strich Fillet

items.description: Given the number of times the Cross Strich handed you your arse on a plate, you can't help but grin as your prepare to tuck into this roast dinner with gusto.
items.name: Roast Cross Strich Fillet

items.description: This potion will teleport its drinker to the stagecoach station in Astrub. Fresh mint has been added to mask the smell of dead rat, but the taste remains unchanged. Drink it the moment you wake up - that way, nobody will even notice.
items.name: Stagecoach Potion

items.description: Use this scroll to learn the Hands Behind Back emote.
items.name: Emote Scroll: Hands Behind Back

items.description: Use this scroll to learn the Open a Pocket Portal emote.
items.name: Emote Scroll: Open a Pocket Portal

items.description: Use this scroll to learn the Locate a Portal emote.
items.name: Emote Scroll: Locate a Portal

items.description: Always dreamt of looking like an Antrezure? Now, thanks to state-of-the-art advances in dimensional technomagic, YOU CAN!
items.name: Antrezure Eidolonic Veil

items.description: Always dreamt of looking like a Powa Drhell? Now, thanks to state-of-the-art advances in dimensional technomagic, YOU CAN!
items.name: Powa Drhell Eidolonic Veil

items.description: Always dreamt of looking like a Levitrof? Now, thanks to state-of-the-art advances in dimensional technomagic, YOU CAN!
items.name: Levitrof Eidolonic Veil

items.description: Always dreamt of looking like a Kamasterisk? Now, thanks to state-of-the-art advances in dimensional technomagic, YOU CAN!
items.name: Kamasterisk Eidolonic Veil

items.description: Use this scroll to learn the Magnifying Glass emote.
items.name: Emote Scroll: Magnifying Glass

items.description: Use this scroll to learn the Beg emote.
items.name: Emote Scroll: Beg

items.description: Use this scroll to learn the Hit Your Forehead emote.
items.name: Emote Scroll: Hit Your Forehead

items.description: Use this scroll to learn the Look for Treasure emote.
items.name: Emote Scroll: Look for Treasure

items.description: The instructions are clear enough... Empty the contents into exactly the right geyser on Frigost Island to create a rainbow whose opposite end may well indicate the location of a hypothetical buried treasure which may or may not have already been found. The potion's secondary use is as a drink which will teleport you to the treasure hunt building.
items.name: Treasure Hunter Potion

items.description: When you drink this potion, you'll be teleported to the portal room in the Dimensional Voyagers' Tower. If everything goes to plan, that is.
items.name: Dimensional Voyager Potion

items.description: Use this scroll to learn the Enutrof class's special emote.
items.name: Emote Scroll: Greed

items.description: You ransacked the Enutoughs' land, going so far as to steal their chests. Was it really worth the risk?
items.name: Enutough Chest

items.description: You ransacked the Drhellers' land, going so far as to steal their chests. Was it really worth the risk?
items.name: Drheller Chest

items.description: You ransacked the Strongboxers' land, going so far as to steal their chests. Was it really worth the risk?
items.name: Strongboxer Chest

items.description: When used to make soup, this divine stone will make you a divine prospector... For a while, at least.
items.name: Enutrof's Stone

items.description: This chest contains Totankama's legendary treasure. What's inside? Open it and find out! You don't believe in curses, right? Good.
items.name: Totankama's Chest

items.description: It's hard to know if this is really Gein's chest. Maybe it's Gein's Double's chest's double.
items.name: Gein's Chest

items.description: Stellia might hide her puppets in it. Or her clubs.
items.name: Stellia's Chest

items.description: Have you always dreamed of looking like a Blundergus? Now, with the power of dimensional technomagic, it's possible!
items.name: Blundergus Eidolonic Veil

items.description: Have you always dreamed of looking like a Trechepeira? Now, with the power of dimensional technomagic, it's possible!
items.name: Trechepeira Eidolonic Veil

items.description: Have you always dreamed of looking like a Terristocrat? Now, with the power of dimensional technomagic, it's possible!
items.name: Terristocrat Eidolonic Veil

items.description: Have you always dreamed of looking like a Tortryck? Now, with the power of dimensional technomagic, it's possible!
items.name: Tortryck Eidolonic Veil

items.description: Drink this potion to be transported to Minotoror Island, to the Sanctuary of a Hundred Detours. Warning: only functions if you have already met Apisaph.
items.name: Apisaph's Potion

items.description: This chest smells heavily of fungus. Maybe it's actually a shoe box.
items.name: Dremoan Chest

items.description: You ransacked the Dark Court's land, going so far as to steal their chests. Was it really worth the risk?
items.name: Dark Court Chest

items.description: You ransacked the Necrotick's land, going so far as to steal their chests. Was it really worth the risk?
items.name: Necrotick Chest

items.description: You ransacked the Malitiamen's land, going so far as to steal their chests. Was it really worth the risk?
items.name: Malitiamen Chest

items.description: This chest was hermetically sealed to be resistant to your Corcodyl tears.
items.name: Mastigator's Chest

items.description: This box contains one or several map fragments. If you don't know how to read a map, you can resell them to adventurers who are a bit more clever.
items.name: Inisignificant Box of Fragments

items.description: This box contains one or several map fragments. If you don't know how to read a map, you can resell them to adventurers who are a bit more clever.
items.name: Rusty Box of Fragments

items.description: This box contains one or several map fragments. If you don't know how to read a map, you can resell them to adventurers who are a bit more clever.
items.name: Intriguing Box of Fragments

items.description: This box contains one or several map fragments. If you don't know how to read a map, you can resell them to adventurers who are a bit more clever.
items.name: Surprising Box of Fragments

items.description: This box contains one or several map fragments. If you don't know how to read a map, you can resell them to adventurers who are a bit more clever.
items.name: Solid Box of Fragments

items.description: This box contains one or several map fragments. If you don't know how to read a map, you can resell them to adventurers who are a bit more clever.
items.name: Heavy Box of Fragments

items.description: This box contains one or several map fragments. If you don't know how to read a map, you can resell them to adventurers who are a bit more clever.
items.name: Sparkling Box of Fragments

items.description: This box contains one or several map fragments. If you don't know how to read a map, you can resell them to adventurers who are a bit more clever.
items.name: Imposing Box of Fragments

items.description: This box contains one or several map fragments. If you don't know how to read a map, you can resell them to adventurers who are a bit more clever.
items.name: Impressive Box of Fragments

items.description: This box contains one or several map fragments. If you don't know how to read a map, you can resell them to adventurers who are a bit more clever.
items.name: Magistral Box of Fragments

items.description: There was a time when this strong beer was served to prisoners condemned to death. Every so often, the beer alone was enough to do the trick.
items.name: Torturer's Beer

items.description: Dissolved in vinegar or some bad wine, this bony finger will make you more treacherous than you've ever been... temporarily, at least.
items.name: Sram's Phalanges

items.description: This scroll lets you learn the special Rogue class emote.
items.name: Emote Scroll: Explosive

items.description: Always dreamt of looking like an Elfacet? Now, thanks to state-of-the-art advances in technomagic, YOU CAN!
items.name: Elfacet Eidolonic Veil

items.description: Always dreamt of looking like a Twentoo? Now, thanks to state-of-the-art advances in technomagic, YOU CAN!
items.name: Twentoo Eidolonic Veil

items.description: Always dreamt of looking like a Hystairkal? Now, thanks to state-of-the-art advances in technomagic, YOU CAN!
items.name: Hystairkal Eidolonic Veil

items.description: Always dreamt of looking like an Ickyrus? Now, thanks to state-of-the-art advances in technomagic, YOU CAN!
items.name: Ickyrus Eidolonic Veil

items.description: Use this scroll to learn the Whistle emote.
items.name: Emote Scroll: Whistle

items.description: Use this scroll to learn the Dance emote.
items.name: Dance

items.description: Use this scroll to learn the Kamarena emote.
items.name: Emote Scroll: Kamarena

items.description: This is where Akornaddikt stores his acorns for winter. Only touch it if you're ready to face his squirrely wrath!
items.name: Akornaddikt's Chest

items.description: With this watch, you can continue to live in the past. Don't forget to pepper your speech with interjections of "Things were so much better in my day!"
items.name: Watch Running Slow

items.description: With this watch, you can become eternally insatiable, always in a hurry to see what life will throw at you next.
items.name: Watch Running Fast

items.description: A pinch of Xelor's Sand in your morning coffee won't prevent you from being late, but it will make you a little smarter... only temporarily, of course.
items.name: Xelor's Sand

items.description: This chest materialised as a result of the perfect synchronisation of Xelorium's spacetime continuum.
items.name: Xelomorph Chest

items.description: This chest materialised as a result of the perfect synchronisation of Xelorium's spacetime continuum.
items.name: Altdemon Chest

items.description: This chest materialised as a result of the perfect synchronisation of Xelorium's spacetime continuum.
items.name: Fugitive Chest

items.description: Use this scroll to learn the Xelor class's special emote.
items.name: Emote Scroll: Timeless

items.description: This chest contains the treasures of all the pirates who took their loot with them to their watery graves.
items.name: Scampihorse's Chest

items.description: This perfumed chest won't leave you cold.
items.name: Panthyrozy's Chest

items.description: This chest contains many ointments that can be used to heal people.
items.name: Brumen's Chest

items.description: Use this scroll to learn the Eliotrope class's special emote.
items.name: Emote Scroll: Transcendent

items.description: A good slug of this and you'll be teleported to the Eliotrope Temple. Known side effects: hiccups, apparition of in-laws, hair loss, dog breath, untied shoelaces, successive red traffic lights.
items.name: Eliotrope Elixir

items.description: Information about Eliotropes.
items.name: Eliotrope's Portal

items.description: You can use this potion to change class.
items.name: Class Change Potion

items.description: Use this scroll to learn the Bolgrot's Wrath emote.
items.name: Emote Scroll: Bolgrot's Wrath

items.description: This Fairywork is popular when celebrating the arrival of spring. Caution: Inhaling the powder has been known to create psychedelic hallucinations as powerful as the Fairywork itself.
items.name: Coloured Fairywork

items.description: Use this scroll to learn the Foggernaut class's special emote.
items.name: Emote Scroll: Steamy

items.description: After having drunk it, you'll talk in metallic noises and punctuate your sentences with beeps and whistles.
items.name: Droid Potion

items.description: The ads for this potion assure you that it's capable of waking the dead. But they don't mention what happens when you spray it on the living...
items.name: Raid Mohr Potion

items.description: The Xelor lobby is trying to outlaw the sale of this potion based on a whole bunch of made-up pretexts, simply because it threatens their monopoly. Any resemblance to any or all existing lobbies is purely coincidental.
items.name: Divination Potion

items.description: This potion was invented by an alchemist who wanted to keep the uneducated away from his creations. It had the opposite effect though - it draw the attention of many Astrubians.
items.name: Rad Dit Potion

items.description: Ecaflips appreciate that this potion lets them tempt fate with a stroke of luck.
items.name: Field Potion

items.description: This potion is served to the city's condemned just before their decapitation.
items.name: Praying Potion

items.description: Creators abuse this potion when they're short on ideas.
items.name: Pythag Potion

items.description: Alchemists sell the Margedelweiss Potion as a Dofus detector. Of course, Astrubians have cleaned out the stock.
items.name: Margedelweiss Potion

items.description: Is justice immutable in your eyes? Are you the victim of a hasty condemnation you couldn't contest? This potion will get you back on your feet and continuing your misdeeds discreetly.
items.name: Judj Raid Potion

items.description: An alchemist wanted to reproduce Trools' ability to regenerate. Since taking blood from the source seemed to miss the point, the alchemist decided to synthesize it instead.
items.name: Trool's Blood

items.description: Pandawas look down on the exportation of this non-alcoholic potion.
items.name: Tri Potion

items.description: For the dead who aren't quite dead, and still have a lot to make up for.
items.name: Raid Mption Potion

items.description: This potion won't make you a super warrior. Reported side-effects include: hairy tails, primate transformation.
items.name: Goku Potion

items.description: According to some rumours, Emile is the killer. This potion was created to give the victims a second chance.
items.name: Raid Izded Potion

items.description: The tears of the Goddess are rumoured to heal many injuries, but that doesn't explain why her disciples are such wimpy crybabies.
items.name: Tear of Eniripsa

items.description: Used as a lotion, it will make you young and pretty, even if you're a man.
items.name: Donzel Potion

items.description: This potion is great for getting the injured back on their feet and out massacring innocent creatures.
items.name: Revitalizing Potion

items.description: The mould in this potion is not hazardous to your health - so long as you're already dead.
items.name: Cheesemonger Potion

items.description: The minstrel Davyd created this bread for people who, like him, don't mince words.
items.name: White Bread

items.description: This bread gets its name from the way it's prepared, namely by a red-headed baker named Matthew.
items.name: Gingerbread

items.description: This waffle is a particular favourite of many politicians. The most interesting thing is what you put on it.
items.name: Waffle

items.description: This cake first appeared in Astrub. Since then, it's become quite popular and can be found near Zaaps and in the marketplaces of numerous cities.
items.name: Golden Waffle

items.description: Trools have a tendency to confuse this bread with a hat. No one's quite certain why.
items.name: Faluche

items.description: The Bearman himself perfected the recipe of this bread, inspired by a particularly bad bout of indigestion.
items.name: Burnet

items.description: One thing you've got to remember: tortillas are like pies – they've better well-filled.
items.name: Tortilla

items.description: This dish used to be quite popular at drinking parties on the coral beach.
items.name: Burrito

items.description: It's like a pita, only not.
items.name: Fouace

items.description: Here's a fish that will never again try to slip out of your hands.
items.name: Rotisserie Eel

items.description: A favourite amongst paranoids, investigators, and tax inspectors.
items.name: Rotisserie Rock Eel

items.description: Revenge is a dish best served cold. Or like this.
items.name: Baked Sea Bream

items.description: Royal revenge is a dish best served cold. Or like this.
items.name: Baked Royal Sea Bream

items.description: When it's cooked this way, this fish reminds you of the feast the Kanniballs organised when your grandfather passed away.
items.name: Monkfish Salad

items.description: Butchers look poorly on this competing salad being on the market.
items.name: Humonkfish Salad

items.description: The Kanniballs created this recipe, but since their diet is frowned upon in Allister's kingdom, Amaknians have adapted it with fish.
items.name: Cod Stew

items.description: This deluxe dish is only available from Kanniball chefs because of the rarity of Bearded Cod.
items.name: Bearded Cod Stew

items.description: During difficult fights, imagine your teammates in the place of this fish.
items.name: Tench Matelote

items.description: You're quaking with fear at the idea that this fish could be a reincarnated teammate.
items.name: Haunted Tench Matelote

items.description: If you play with fire too much, you'll get burned. A lesson that's just a bit too late for this fish.
items.name: Panned Swordfish

items.description: This fish's dreams of grandeur led it all the way to this plate.
items.name: Panned Quixote Swordfish

items.description: This enormous sack contains an impressive quantity of Ginseng.
items.name: Sack of Ginseng

items.description: This enormous sack contains an impressive quantity of Belladonna.
items.name: Sack of Belladonna

items.description: This enormous sack contains an impressive quantity of Mandrake.
items.name: Sack of Mandrake

items.description: This enormous sack contains an impressive quantity of Hazel Wood.
items.name: Sack of Hazel Wood

items.description: This enormous sack contains an impressive quantity of Corn.
items.name: Sack of Corn

items.description: This enormous sack contains an impressive quantity of Millet.
items.name: Sack of Millet

items.description: This enormous sack contains an impressive quantity of Eels.
items.name: Sack of Eels

items.description: This enormous sack contains an impressive quantity of Sea Bream.
items.name: Sack of Sea Bream

items.description: This enormous sack contains an impressive quantity of Monkfish.
items.name: Sack of Monkfish

items.description: This enormous sack contains an impressive quantity of Cod.
items.name: Sack of Cod

items.description: This enormous sack contains an impressive quantity of Tench.
items.name: Sack of Tench

items.description: This enormous sack contains an impressive quantity of Swordfish.
items.name: Sack of Swordfish

items.description: This insipid dish is part of the traditional Incarnam cuisine.
items.name: Flesh Bullion

items.description: Ronan the Barbarian's mother frequently told him to drink his soup to become big. One can guess that he must not have ever listened.
items.name: Famished Sunflower Soup

items.description: Contrary to what any Iops might have told you, you can actually eat this anywhere, not just the beach.
items.name: Beach Sweet

items.description: The method of preparing this meat before cooking it in paper guarantees an inimitable taste.
items.name: Sponge Mob Sweet

items.description: This beignet, adored by Rekojeht, makes a disturbing smile play across his lips every time he has one.
items.name: Batofu Beignet

items.description: It will have you dancing in the fields, if you weren't already. Admit it. You were.
items.name: Field Pan Fry

items.description: Children prefer food that is simple, fatty, sugary or salty to fancy food and peppers.
items.name: Treechnidian Round in Pepper Sauce

items.description: This ball shines more than the ones you make with your boogers, but rest assured, it's harder to flick with your fingers.
items.name: Golden Scarabugly Ball

items.description: The best thing about this meat isn't the taste, but the noise the Vilinsekt makes when it's cooked.
items.name: Vilinsekt Grillade

items.description: Thankfully, Kickroach is impossible to hear, because the obscenities that it shouted while being cooked would make even a Rogue blush.
items.name: Kickroach Grillade

items.description: It doesn't matter where you get the onions - what matters is that you get them.
items.name: Onion-Flavoured Marrow Bone

items.description: This dish gives off an odour strangely similar to your breath when you wake up, which is why cooks often use it to keep stray cats away.
items.name: Onion-Flavoured Ronin Chafer Marrow Bone

items.description: Since there are idiots everywhere for whom common sense is nothing but a legend, this dish comes with the notice: "Do not consume while burning - risk of serious burn."
items.name: Blop Bullion

items.description: This off-white, aniseed-flavoured liquid squirting into your mouth when you bite into this larva reminds you of certain drunken nights.
items.name: Salted Shin Larva

items.description: Accompanied by potatoes, this dish is perfect for getting Bandits ready for their future stays in Brakmar jails.
items.name: Bandit Cottage Pie

items.description: Accompanied by potato peels, this dish is perfect for getting Bandits ready for their future stays in Brakmar jails.
items.name: Smiths' Chest Cottage Pie

items.description: Not knowing what to do with their tripe, the Bworks decided to eat it to give them courage.
items.name: Bwork Andouillette

items.description: After eating this dish, your breath will be able to kill a Bwork.
items.name: Bworkette Andouillette

items.description: A hole in the sand, a fire on the beach, food rolled in ash and everything's taken care of. The hardest part is getting a Coralator to participate.
items.name: Ashy Coral

items.description: A hole in the sand, a fire on the beach, food rolled in ash and everything's taken care of. The hardest part is getting the Great Coralator out of his grotto.
items.name: Ashy Great Coral

items.description: Less violent than the last time you took a pie to the kisser, this pie is also lighter.
items.name: Ash-Coated Bulb Tart

items.description: A Pandawa custom says the Bulbig Brotha Tart should be shared with your family.
items.name: Ash-Coated Bulbig Brotha Tart

items.description: This is what happens when a Blop drowns.
items.name: Blop Marinade

items.description: This is what happens when a Royal Blop tries to learn to swim.
items.name: Royal Blop Marinade

items.description: This fatty, sugary, and salty mixture is recommended if you're managing bad cholesterol, diabetes, or gout.
items.name: Spiced Jelly

items.description: This fatty, sugary, and salty mixture is recommended if you want bad cholesterol, diabetes, or gout.
items.name: Spiced Royal Jelly

items.description: I LIKE TURTLES!
items.name: Boiled Turtle

items.description: Sometimes, a Kanniball's rite of passage ceremony goes very wrong, much to the delight of their peers.
items.name: Kanniball Andouillette

items.description: When the Kanniball chief is no longer fit to rule, he's divided among the members of his tribe. The one that accidentally stabs their palate with a bone while eating the old chief becomes the new one.
items.name: Kanniball Andchain Andouillette

items.description: This potion won't make you more attractive, but it might make your hair grow.
items.name: Axle Wose Potion

items.description: Believing that a farmer had been used as the basis of this dish, a Iop knight decided to avenge his death. Which explains the decided lack of rats in the fields.
items.name: Country Rat Jowl

items.description: There is only one way to cook this dish, which makes the sight of it all the more unsettling.
items.name: Steamed Ethereal Tripe

items.description: There is only one way to cook this dish, which makes the sight of it in the dark possible.
items.name: Steamed Shiny Ethereal Tripe

items.description: The advantage of Crackler Bullion is that it can be directly cooked on a stone, giving a smooth and even broth.
items.name: Crackler Bullion

items.description: Drinking this bullion won't make you a legend, but you'll avoid dying of hunger and thirst, and hey, that's a start.
items.name: Legendary Crackler Bullion

items.description: There's not a lot there to eat, but one single mouthful will be enough to send you to Ingloriom.
items.name: Grilled Marrow Bone

items.description: There's not a lot there to eat, but one single mouthful will be enough to send you to the Shustuft Crust.
items.name: Grilled Gourlo the Terrible Marrow Bone

items.description: Along with a glass of cawwot juice, this dish is positively regal.
items.name: Smoked Wa Wobot Jowl

items.description: The acidity of the lemon offsets the high PH of the offal, which almost makes it edible.
items.name: Kitsou Offal Lemonade

items.description: The acidity of the lemon offsets the high PH of the offal, which almost makes it good.
items.name: Daggero Offal Lemonade

items.description: For a moment, you wonder if it's the remains of last night's vomit, then you remember that your Bow Wow already took care of that mess for you.
items.name: Brain Salad

items.description: You're too hungry to ask yourself if this is leftovers of last night's vomit.
items.name: Dark Vlad Brain Salad

items.description: Frying makes up for the lack of fat in vegetarian dishes.
items.name: Vegetarian Stir Fry

items.description: This savoury dish will make vegetarians as happy as carnivores.
items.name: Dark Treechnidian Round Grillade

items.description: Butchers refuse to taste this food because they worry they'll be turned into a Treechnid.
items.name: Ancestral Treechnid Round Grillade

items.description: The less you know about this terrine, the better.
items.name: Arak-hai Terrine in Jelly

items.description: Theoretically, cooking this dish will have killed the Arak-hai eggs. If not, you'll soon have a lot more children to take care of.
items.name: Rac Queen Terrine in Jelly

items.description: It's not advisable to drink the juice that accompanies this dish, unless you want to have a shape similar to a Pandora.
items.name: Boiled Marrow Bone

items.description: This dish is so ridiculously small that it would only satisfy a Vilinsekt.
items.name: Boiled LeChouque Marrow Bone

items.description: A culinary specialty of Moon Island, this recipe disappeared after the arrival of the Kanniballs.
items.name: Exotic Salad

items.description: Since they arrived on Moon Island, the Kanniballs have adapted the recipe of this exotic salad.
items.name: Exotic Brain Salad

items.description: To appreciate the true value of this dish, you must add Apis and dirt. Or at least, that's the way Iops explain it.
items.name: Krtek Cottage Pie

items.description: The taste of this meat will be worth the twelve hours you'll have to wait for it to cook.
items.name: Braised Gobball

items.description: Obviously, it's not the actual Koolich, because you'd have to cut down every tree in Amakna just to cook it.
items.name: Braised Koolich

items.description: This meat can keep for decades without its taste or nutritional qualities changing.
items.name: Krismahlo Pemmican

items.description: Giles Verne advises Foggernauts to take this meat with them on all their long trips.
items.name: Puppet Master Pemmican

items.description: It takes a lot of spice to mask the metallic taste of this dish.
items.name: Spiced Strongboxer

items.description: The spices accentuate the auriferous taste of this dish, which should satisfy the greediest Enutrof.
items.name: Spiced Brutatax

items.description: The stuffing is comprised of everything the Ouassinge absorbed before dying. With luck, there are even some edible parts.
items.name: Stuffed Ouassinge Stomach

items.description: It's not a bad idea to eat before combat in order to excuse your inefficiency.
items.name: Rat Jowl Stew

items.description: Only hardened Brakmarians are able to swallow this meat without belching flames. So Oto Mustam deliberately distributed it to young recruits during important battles.
items.name: Black Rat Jowl Stew

items.description: Notable Bontarians eat this dish with an infamous taste in order to seem different and show they're not like everyone else - and, indeed, no one else eats it.
items.name: White Rat Jowl Stew

items.description: Otomai's disciples adore consuming anything made from alcohol or herbs, which led them to create this recipe.
items.name: Herb-Rubbed Sirloin Steak Salad

items.description: It's well known that eat Silf the Greater Bherb accompanied by cocktails loosens tongues. Certain of Otomai's more unscrupulous disciples have even used this fact to obtain information about the Turquoise Dofus.
items.name: Silf the Greater Bherb Sirloin Steak Salad

items.description: Many chefs have tried to reproduce this recipe by putting common Crobaks directly in the oven, but without success.
items.name: Baked Crobak Liver Paté

items.description: Not everyone can cook this meat, and even fewer can pay for it.
items.name: Baked Lord Crow Liver Paté

items.description: It's slightly more effective for digging a small hole than being used as food.
items.name: Koalak Sausage

items.description: This pudding has a pretty bad taste, but it's still popular with Astrubian youths.
items.name: Skeunk Sausage

items.description: This is what happens when a Royal Rainbow Blop confuses a plate with its bathtub.
items.name: Royal Rainbow Blop Marinade

items.description: From now on, you'll be able to draw the Minotoror's labyrinth in your plate.
items.name: Minos Hock Stew

items.description: Whatever the Minotoror was plotting doesn't matter now that it's in your plate.
items.name: Mintoror Hock Stew

items.description: Tastes like Tofu.
items.name: Tofu Strip Pan Fry

items.description: Not everyone gets a chance to taste this royal dish.
items.name: Royal Tofu Strip Pan Fry

items.description: This balanced dish comes with it's own drink to accompany it.
items.name: Pandissident Liver Salad

items.description: Consumed in excess, this salad quickly goes to the head, and will make you do inadmissible things, like vomiting in your boots, or worse, your neighbours'.
items.name: Pandora Master Liver Salad

items.description: This pie has a more regular shape than the "pies" your mount creates.
items.name: Grilled Xelomorph Pie

items.description: Some prefer it square, some like it triangular, and the worst are those that refuse to eat it if it's not shaped like jigsaw pieces.
items.name: Grilled Fraktal Pie

items.description: Each year, the stupidest Zoths get together at the Zaap to compare the length of their sausages. The longest gets the honour of being revered as a god by his peers.
items.name: Zoth Sausage

items.description: No matter what you've been told, jelly will never replace real fresh meat.
items.name: Tanukouï San Breast in Jelly

items.description: The original recipe used water from the Shrouded Canals for the marinade, but most tourists couldn't handle it and ended up in the Os-Piss.
items.name: Marinated Malitiaman Flank

items.description: Much progress has been made recently in the treatment of the Shrouded Canals water used for the marinade, which has reduced the number of consumer deaths by an order of magnitude.
items.name: Marinated Captain Scarlight Flank

items.description: Everyone has their own special way of preparing this dish: rolling it in their armpits, mud, or, rarely, flour.
items.name: Firefoux Roulade

items.description: Few cooks dare prepare this dish - not because it's difficult to prepare, but because collecting the ingredients can be fatal.
items.name: Peki Peki Roulade

items.description: How short-tempered can it be after having been sautéed? Apparently, the answer is: very.
items.name: Sautéed Short-Tempered Treechnidian Round

items.description: You'll be able to invite your in-laws to dinner without them thinking you're trying to poison them.
items.name: Sautéed Soft Oak Round

items.description: This 100% vegetarian round should be served just barely cooked.
items.name: Rotisserie Fleurizome Round

items.description: If you eat it, you'll feel better.
items.name: Rotisserie Tynril Round

items.description: If, after throwing one of these six-sided die, you get an eight, you've probably spent too much time on Nolifis Island.
items.name: Diced Amakna Rat Jowl

items.description: This dish has a slight taste of sausage pizza.
items.name: Diced Sphincter Cell Jowl

items.description: This meat is served to adventurers who want to brave the ocean's fury without ever leaving the Gobball fields.
items.name: Breaded Ectoplasmic Meat

items.description: Be careful Buck Anear doesn't come to take this piece of meat back from your stomach.
items.name: Breaded Buck Anear Meat

items.description: If you'd like to live a long, healthy life, avoid inviting Enutoughs to share this meal with you.
items.name: Spiced Drheller Muzzle

items.description: When Dhyan Fossi asked you to calm the Drhossil down, she never suspected you'd use such cruel methods.
items.name: Spiced Drhossil Muzzle

items.description: When you think of all the slaves dying of starvation every day in the Stontusk Desert, you'll be more appreciative of this dish's taste.
items.name: Minotot Hock Stew

items.description: Not to be confused with Sim, an old Enutrof whose as funny as your Dad's jokes...
items.name: Sym Filet

items.description: The rules of gastronomy say this meat should be eaten cooked every other day, and raw the days in between.
items.name: Kimbo Filet

items.description: No one is singing the praises of this terrine.
items.name: Toadorous Terrine

items.description: There's always a small risk of breaking a tooth while eating this terrine.
items.name: Obsidemon Terrine

items.description: The stuffing is easy to prepare: you just need to gather the remains of several adventures who failed to defeat the Giant Kralove.
items.name: Stuffed Giant Kralove Stomach

items.description: This steak gives off an intoxicating perfumed odour which awakens males' reproductive instinct, and repels females.
items.name: Fuji Snowfoux Steak

items.description: No matter what it's made of, puddings remain a favourite dish of Twelvians.
items.name: Altdemon Pudding

items.description: This long and large sausage will fill with pleasure those lucky enough to get a taste.
items.name: XLII Sausage

items.description: Serving this meat cooked instead of raw is a sacrilege which should be punished with being drowned in cheap wine.
items.name: Bwork Laap

items.description: As you may have heard, the longer it is, the less short it is.
items.name: Bworker Laap

items.description: These mushrooms will help you understand everything.
items.name: Fried Mushrooms

items.description: Frying is the only cooking method known to inhibit the deadly substances found in these mushrooms. And that means that all the other methods had to be tested before they were known not to work.
items.name: Fried Ougaa Mushrooms

items.description: This dish, targeted at tourists, is but a pale and cheap imitation of the famous salad with Rattedaugue vinaigrette.
items.name: Vegetarian Plate

items.description: This dish was developed for consumers whose palates couldn't handle a salad dressed with Rattedaugue vinaigrette.
items.name: Vegetarian Plate with Korriander

items.description: This ball has the consistency and flavour of an old booger.
items.name: Necrotick Ball

items.description: This ball has the consistency and flavour of an old Trool booger.
items.name: Toxoliath Ball

items.description: The nicest thing you can say about this dish is that it looks a lot better than it tastes.
items.name: Sakaian Salad

items.description: Grohlum is a heavyweight, everyone knows that. This salad is no exception, and only the most solid stomachs can digest it without flinching.
items.name: Grohlum Sakaian Salad

items.description: Used correctly, this steak can be used as a weapon or projectile during protests.
items.name: Kolosso Flank Steak with Cream

items.description: Despite its imposing size, this leg has negative calories. So you can munch on it all day without gaining a kilopod. But really, would you want to?
items.name: Obscurantus Leg

items.description: After eating this leg, you'll feel an emptiness in your stomach. Which is why eating it is forbidden during most eating contests.
items.name: Shadow Leg

items.description: These dice are great for playing silently, even when the only surface available is a glass or marble table.
items.name: Diced Meat in Jelly

items.description: If your players have the annoying habit of throwing their dice at you when you ask them to roll them, give them these dice instead. Not only will you be able to finish your games relatively bruise-free, you won't be hungry.
items.name: Diced Merkator Meat in Jelly

items.description: Straight out of a horror show, this gelatinous fake egg has no chance of passing for a Dofus.
items.name: Molecular Krobe Egg

items.description: This is the absolute latest in modern light cooking: an empty plate to keep you from gaining weight, and an exorbitant price to help your purse with the same thing.
items.name: Molecular Protoz'orror Egg

items.description: This dish was created for folks whose teeth have long been lost to the ravages of time and become a part of the fossil record.
items.name: Enutough Jelly

items.description: They don't serve just anything at the King's table, nor just anyONE.
items.name: Nidas Jelly

items.description: In Srambad, they quickly ran into problems with storing bodies. A brilliant solution allows them to simultaneously solve the problem of having too many mouths to feed...
items.name: Dark Court Pasties

items.description: Don't think that the Queen of Thieves would be a simple mouthful - that would be underestimating her.
items.name: Queen of Thieves Pasties

items.description: This recipe was invented by Two-Fingers when he tried out cooking. He never imagined that it would be so popular with the Astrubian populace.
items.name: Fugitive Eggplant Quenelle

items.description: Anyone possessing this Quenelle risks being stopped by the Order Errant.
items.name: Vortex Eggplant Quenelle

items.description: This bag contains several aubergines.
items.name: Bag of Aubergines

items.description: This bag contains several Eternal Ashes.
items.name: Bag of Eternal Ashes

items.description: This bag contains several Cherries.
items.name: Bag of Cherries

items.description: This bag contains several Lemons.
items.name: Bag of Lemons

items.description: This barrel contains several Tasty Juices.
items.name: Barrel of Tasty Juice

items.description: This barrel contains several Waters.
items.name: Barrel of Drinking Water

items.description: This bag contains several Spices.
items.name: Bag of Spices

items.description: This bag contains several Babbages.
items.name: Bag of Babbage Leaves

items.description: This bag contains several Jelly Blubbers.
items.name: Bag of Jelly Blubber

items.description: This bag contains several Beans.
items.name: Bag of Beans

items.description: This barrel contains several Frying Oils.
items.name: Barrel of Frying Oil

items.description: This bag contains several measures of Pepper.
items.name: Bag of Pepper

items.description: This bag contains several measures of Salt.
items.name: Bag of Salt

items.description: This bag contains several onions.
items.name: Bag of Onions

items.description: This bag contains several measures of Magical Cure.
items.name: Bag of Magical Cure

items.description: This bag contains several Temporal Powders.
items.name: Bag of Temporal Powder

items.description: This bag contains several Resins.
items.name: Bag of Resin

items.description: This barrel contains several Scurvion Bloods.
items.name: Barrel of Scurvion Blood

items.description: This beer helps reinforce the skull and other bones, which explains why Chafers are so headstrong.
items.name: Atolmond Beer

items.description: Created for the elite Djaulian, in all ways better than common plebes, this beer makes one megalomaniacal and egocentric. Unfortunately, it doesn't make one smart.
items.name: Djaul Beer

items.description: This beer is intended for those who don't have the means to get a Djaul Beer.
items.name: Misery Beer

items.description: The only difference between this beer and Bwork beer is the sulphurous aftertaste.
items.name: Bworkball Beer

items.description: Unlike your sweetheart, this log is both sweet smelling and sweet tasting. Too bad it won't be more than a single mouthful.
items.name: Ash Log

items.description: Unlike your sweetheart, this log is both sweet smelling and sweet tasting. Too bad it won't be more than a single mouthful.
items.name: Chestnut Log

items.description:
You can upgrade an alliance prism by adding this module and then extracting the magic essence of any thingamajig you want in order to craft other stuff, which you can sell for ten times the price of a whatchamacallit.
It has been set up to fairly distribute the gains between the alliance and the recycler (50% for the character and 50% for the alliance).
items.name: Fair Trade Recycler

items.description:
You can upgrade an alliance prism by adding this module and then extracting the magic essence of any thingamajig you want in order to craft other stuff, which you can sell for ten times the price of a whatchamacallit.
It has been set up to distribute the gains in favour of the alliance (30% for the character and 90% for the alliance).
items.name: Collective Recycler

items.description: If cooks like to keep this recipe a closely guarded secret, it's not because they're afraid of it being copied, but in case it will be brought up in court.
items.name: Meatball

items.description: Ever popular with the kiddies, this fritter is also favoured by adults who hate knowing exactly what they're eating.
items.name: Astrubian Fritter

items.description: As insipid as its namesake, this fritter is the recommended diet for a Iop.
items.name: Fortifying Astrubian Fritter

items.description: This is the favourite meal of Undertakers and Goblin merchants.
items.name: Meat Roulade

items.description: The illustrious Ronan the Barbarian rolls these himself under the armpits of his fallen foes.
items.name: Fortifying Meat Roulade

items.description: The tartness of the lemon effectively neutralises the deadly bacteria that have developed in this meat.
items.name: Lemon Papillote

items.description: If this dish doesn't kill you, it'll only make you stronger, that's for certain.
items.name: Fortifying Lemon Papillote

items.description: When the fishing's bad, Sufokians fall back on this salad, which contains all the protein they need. Just don't ask where all the protein in this salad comes from.
items.name: Sufokian Salad

items.description: The Sufokians quickly spotted that eating seafood stimulated their brains, but not their muscles. That's why they came up with this recipe.
items.name: Fortified Sufokian Salad

items.description: Gordo McRamsay himself invented this platter of greasy carbs, which soon became a staple at Amaknian festivals.
items.name: Amaknian Chips

items.description: This princely dish of devastatingly complex haute cuisine is mainly eaten by the nobility at Amaknian festivals.
items.name: Fortified Amaknian Chips

items.description: If you want killer breath, look no further than this cottage pie, and eat it for every meal.
items.name: Cottage Pie with Onion

items.description: Your breath will also be fortified after a mouthful of this rather powerful cottage pie.
items.name: Fortifying Cottage Pie with Onion

items.description: In Brakmar, the recipe for this dish has been adapted to include genuine morsels of Bontarian Militiamen.
items.name: Bontarian Terrine

items.description: This dish is popular with Bontarian officers who are often out in the field.
items.name: Fortifying Bontarian Terrine

items.description: A favourite of the people, this goulash can be whipped up using any kind of bargain-basement meat.
items.name: Tasty Goulash

items.description: This goulash can only be created using the most rare and select of meats.
items.name: Fortifying Tasty Goulash

items.description: Only women are permitted to cook this dish, which has obviously set the anti-sexist organisations by the ears.
items.name: Countrywoman Pan Fry

items.description: Only women are allowed to eat this dish, which has obviously set the Bow Meow among the pigeons when it comes to the associations for the protection of men's rights.
items.name: Fortifying Countrywoman Pan Fry

items.description: The Brakmarians have hijacked the production of this dish and are now deploying the people who eat it as living bombs.
items.name: Three-Bean Pemmican

items.description: The gastric escapes caused by the digestion of this dish are particularly explosive.
items.name: Fortifying Three-Bean Pemmican

items.description: The Brakmarians have adapted their cooking to fit their environment, which explains the local custom of grilling just about anything, such as roadkill, long-lost relatives, you name it.
items.name: Brakmarian Grillade

items.description: This grillade is difficult to perfect because not every prisoner reacts in the same way to the lava bath.
items.name: Fortifying Brakmarian Grillade

items.description: This dish is highly prized by adventurers who haven't got time to waste on cooking a separate starter, main course and dessert.
items.name: Sweet n' Sour Marinade

items.description: This all-in-one dish is holding its own in the stakes against energy bars.
items.name: Fortifying Sweet n' Sour Marinade

items.description: Black pudding has the reputation of being bigger, grosser, and having a more distinctive flavour than white pudding. It's also black.
items.name: Black Pudding

items.description: Apparently black pudding is stronger than white pudding, but it's impossible to say for sure, as nobody's ever seen them arm-wrestle.
items.name: Fortifying Black Pudding

items.description: If you get into a stew when it comes to combat, you'll end up as cannon fodder.
items.name: Spiced Stew

items.description: Telling the cook they made a hash of it doesn't do justice to this dish.
items.name: Fortified Spiced Stew

items.description: This dish is distributed in military canteens in order to maintain morale.
items.name: Restorative Goulash

items.description: Like an extended visit from your mother-in-law, excessive consumption of this dish can cause hallucinations, depression and memory disorders.
items.name: Fortifying Restorative Goulash

items.description: Nothing particularly interesting about this meat, but it's good stuff all the same.
items.name: Tenderloin

items.description: It seems you can be both tender and firm, as this tenderloin demonstrates.
items.name: Fortifying Tenderloin

items.description: 57 varieties, all of them bland and covered in tomato sauce.
items.name: Hind's Quenelle

items.description: They may not be any good, but they'll make you stronger if your stomach can digest them without bringing them back up.
items.name: Fortifying Hind's Quenelle

items.description: Eat this sausage with respect, because you might find yourself in its place after the next manhunt.
items.name: Game Andouillette

items.description: The uncleansed tripe in this sausage gives this andouillette properties that are highly sought after by both adventurers and bodybuilders alike.
items.name: Fortified Game Andouillette

items.description: Although this is less popular than the ever sought-after sausage sorbet, smoked sausage is still appreciated for the unique taste of the final mouthful.
items.name: Smoked Sausage

items.description: It's mainly due to the extreme elasticity of this shape-memory sausage that adults get told off for playing with their food.
items.name: Fortified Smoked Sausage

items.description:

items.description:
You manage to make out the following words through the bland shell of this Pandawa cookie: "A white Kwak on a lake is never fake!"

Eating this cookie will increase your Agility in exchange for Vitality during your next fight.
items.name: Lemon Fortunawa Cookie

items.description:
You manage to make out the following words through the bland shell of this Pandawa cookie: "Balance is classy. The opposite isn't always true."

Eating this cookie will increase your Intelligence in exchange for Vitality during your next fight.
items.name: Strawberry Fortunawa Cookie

items.description:
You manage to make out the following words through the bland shell of this Pandawa cookie: "Dofus plantus, nerfus sadidus." This cookie tastes like the fortune writer's tears.

Eating this cookie will increase your Strength in exchange for Vitality during your next fight.
items.name: Api Fortunawa Cookie

items.description:
You manage to make out the following words through the bland shell of this Pandawa cookie: "Whoever dirties his quill, darkens his page."

Eating this cookie will increase your Chance in exchange for Vitality during your next fight.
items.name: Plum Fortunawa Cookie

items.description:
You manage to make out the following words through the bland shell of this Pandawa cookie: "The hero reading this message is a Iop!" Finally, someone who appreciates you the way you deserve.

Eating this cookie will increase your Intelligence and Agility in exchange for Vitality during your next fight.
items.name: Strawberry-Lemon Fortunawaduo Cookie

items.description:
You manage to make out the following words through the bland shell of this Pandawa cookie: "This is not a proverb." The message leaves you feeling confused.

Eating this cookie will increase your Strength and Intelligence in exchange for Vitality during your next fight.
items.name: Api-Strawberry Fortunawaduo Cookie

items.description:
You manage to make out the following words through the bland shell of this Pandawa cookie: "Fighting alongside a disciple of Iop teaches you bravery; fighting alongside a disciple of Sram teaches you solitude."

Eating this cookie will increase your Chance and Intelligence in exchange for Vitality during your next fight.
items.name: Plum-Strawberry Fortunawaduo Cookie

items.description:
You manage to make out the following words through the bland shell of this Pandawa cookie: "The Krosmoz contains a world that the world cannot understand."

Eating this cookie will increase your Strength and Agility in exchange for Vitality during your next fight.
items.name: Api-Lemon Fortunawaduo Cookie

items.description:
You manage to make out the following words through the bland shell of this Pandawa cookie: "When shadows disappoint, light remembers." You get a feeling someone is trying to send you a message.

Eating this cookie will increase your Strength and Chance in exchange for Vitality during your next fight.
items.name: Api-Plum Fortunawaduo Cookie

items.description:
You manage to make out the following words through the bland shell of this Pandawa cookie: "For a Rogue, value comes from strategy, not courage."

Eating this cookie will increase your Chance and Agility in exchange for Vitality during your next fight.

items.description: Those are not actually eyeballs floating in the bottle; they're just apriplums. That means they're a lot less creepy than you thought and altogether a poor idea for an Al Howin accessory. But Umeshusu is delicious. Just take a sip and let yourself be carried away on fruit-filled waves of nectar to a land of unsuspected flavour.

If you've always dreamed of wandering like a wayward soul, downing this tankard will make your dream come true until your next fight.
